{{Short description|Construction in order theory}}
{{distinguish|text=the [[Moyal product]], also sometimes referred to as the star product}}
In [[mathematics]], the '''star product''' is a method of combining [[graded poset]]s with unique minimal and maximal elements, preserving the property that the posets are [[Eulerian poset|Eulerian]].

==Definition==
The star product of two [[graded poset]]s <math>(P,\le_P)</math> and <math>(Q,\le_Q)</math>, where <math>P</math> has a unique [[maximal element]] <math>\widehat{1}</math> and <math>Q</math> has a unique minimal element <math>\widehat{0}</math>, is a [[poset]] <math>P*Q</math> on the set <math>(P\setminus\{\widehat{1}\})\cup(Q\setminus\{\widehat{0}\})</math>. We define the [[partial order]] <math>\le_{P*Q}</math> by <math>x\le y</math> if and only if:

:1. <math>\{x,y\}\subset P</math>, and <math>x\le_P y</math>;
:2. <math>\{x,y\}\subset Q</math>, and <math>x\le_Q y</math>; or
:3. <math>x\in P</math> and <math>y\in Q</math>.

In other words, we pluck out the top of <math>P</math> and the bottom of <math>Q</math>, and require that everything in <math>P</math> be smaller than everything in <math>Q</math>.

==Example==
For example, suppose <math>P</math> and <math>Q</math> are the [[Two-element Boolean algebra|Boolean algebra]] on two elements.

{{Dark mode invert|[[Image:star product 1.png|upright=1]]}}

Then <math>P*Q</math> is the poset with the [[Hasse diagram]] below.

{{Dark mode invert|[[Image:star product 3.png|upright=1]]}}

==Properties==
The star product of [[Eulerian poset]]s is Eulerian.
